svg.text: Persistent Data Structures — Immutable Versioned State
Path Copying — Persistent BST/Trie
• Persistent = old versions remain accessible after updates
• Path copying: on update, copy only nodes on root→leaf path
• New root → new version; old root unchanged → old version
• Shared structure: unchanged subtrees shared between versions
• Cost per update: O(log n) new nodes for balanced BST
• Cost per update: O(L) new nodes for trie of depth L
• Total space for k updates: O(n + k log n)
Persistent Segment Tree (Merge Sort Tree)
• Version array: roots[0..k] — one root per version
• Update creates O(log n) new nodes along update path
• Query on version v: traverse from roots[v]
• Offline range kth-smallest: build k versions (sort by value)
query(l,r,k) = walk two version trees simultaneously
• LeetCode 315 (Count Smaller) solvable with persistent seg tree
• Space: O(n log n) for n versions of n-element array
Fat Node & Node Copying Methods
• Fat Node: each node stores list of (value, timestamp) pairs
→ O(1) update, O(log k) query (binary search on timestamp)
→ Space O(k) total; but poor cache behavior
• Node copying (Driscoll et al.): each node has fixed extra fields
→ When extra fields full, copy node + update parent
→ Amortized O(log n) per update, O(log n) per query
• Functional persistence: immutable nodes + garbage collection
→ Natural in Haskell, Clojure, Scala immutable collections
Applications & Real-World Use
• Version control (Git): DAG of immutable tree snapshots
• Undo/redo: version stack of persistent data structure states
• Functional languages: Clojure PersistentHashMap (HAMT)
• React: immutable state → cheap referential equality checks
• Database MVCC: each transaction sees its own consistent snapshot
• Competitive programming: offline range kth-smallest in O(n log n)
• Time-travel debugging: record all state versions, replay any point
• CRDTs: conflict-free replicated data types use persistence ideas
Path copy: O(log n) new nodes/update
Space: O(n + k log n) for k updates
Query any version: O(log n)
Persistent seg tree: O(n log n) space
Used in: Git, MVCC, Clojure, React
